---
title: "A: Alimentary tract and metabolism"
description: "ATC group A for modelers: the level 2 map with example drugs, and modeling notes held with A10 (diabetes) and A02 (acid-related disorders)."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Drugs acting on the gut, on metabolism and on nutrition, from mouthwashes to insulins.
Modeling notes live with the subgroups they belong to: [A10, drugs used in diabetes](a10/), and [A02, drugs for acid related disorders](a02/).

In January 1922 a first pancreatic extract given to Leonard Thompson, 14 and ketoacidotic at Toronto General Hospital, left a sterile abscess and barely moved his glycemia.
Collip's purified extract on 23 January cleared the ketonuria [@vecchioDiscoveryInsulinImportant2018].

|  | Description | In plain terms | Example drug |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **A01** | Stomatological preparations | of the mouth and teeth | Chlorhexidine (A01AB03) / sodium fluoride (A01AA01) |
| [**A02**](a02/) | Drugs for acid related disorders |  | Omeprazole (A02BC01) / pantoprazole (A02BC02) |
| **A03** | Drugs for functional gastrointestinal disorders | gut cramp and motility problems without structural disease | Metoclopramide (A03FA01) / butylscopolamine (A03BB01) |
| **A04** | Antiemetics and antinauseants | stop vomiting and nausea | Ondansetron (A04AA01) / aprepitant (A04AD12) |
| **A05** | Bile and liver therapy |  | Ursodeoxycholic acid (A05AA02) / obeticholic acid (A05AA04) |
| **A06** | Drugs for constipation |  | Macrogol (A06AD15) / lactulose (A06AD11) |
| **A07** | Antidiarrheals, intestinal antiinflammatory/antiinfective agents |  | Mesalazine (A07EC02) / loperamide (A07DA03) |
| **A08** | Antiobesity preparations, excl. diet products |  | Orlistat (A08AB01) / bupropion and naltrexone (A08AA62) |
| **A09** | Digestives, incl. enzymes | replace missing digestive enzymes | Pancreatin, indexed as multienzymes (A09AA02) |
| [**A10**](a10/) | Drugs used in diabetes |  | Metformin (A10BA02) / dapagliflozin (A10BK01) |
| **A11** | Vitamins |  | Colecalciferol (A11CC05) / thiamine (A11DA01) |
| **A12** | Mineral supplements |  | Calcium carbonate (A12AA04) / potassium chloride (A12BA01) |
| **A13** | Tonics | old general-strengthening preparations, not evidence-based | No substance to name: A13A carries no level 5 substances, a residual historical category. |
| **A14** | Anabolic agents for systemic use | tissue-building steroids acting body-wide | Nandrolone (A14AB01) / oxandrolone (A14AA08) |
| **A15** | Appetite stimulants |  | No substance to name: A15 is subdivided no further and holds no substances or DDDs. |
| **A16** | Other alimentary tract and metabolism products | leftovers: mostly rare inherited metabolic disease drugs | Nitisinone (A16AX04) / sapropterin (A16AX07) |
